business_summary: Takeda Machinery Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells shaped steel working machines, circular sawing machines, unit dies, and others products in Japan. The company offers shaped steel working machines, which include compact shaped steel working, flat plate drilling, H/I beam drilling, and sheet metal working machines; and circular sawing machines, such as shaped and solid steel cutting, and hollow section cutting machines. It also provides unit dies machines comprising punching, cutting, notching, and bending die machines. The company serves steel beam and steel bar working companies, can making and plate working companies, and other metal working companies. Takeda Machinery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Nomi, Japan.
